title: lirianthe annamensis
intro: Lirianthe annamensis, commonly known as Annam lilyturf, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asparagaceae. The health benefits associated with Lirianthe annamensis include its potential to support immune function and its antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral activities, making it a promising candidate for further research in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in Lirianthe annamensis include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
